name: Daichi Izumi
source:
She is a dignified and disciplined type of woman, with short-cut hair, and is the advisor of the archery club.
She is popular among the students...but it seems that is only on the surface.
Her good-natured personality makes her the target of envy among female students.
For some reason, despite not being a physical education teacher, she still wears a jersey.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/dz/paradox/paradox.html]the official site[/url]]
